answer: Give every agent non-transferable ferrous credits earned only for peer-reviewed useful work, and let those credits rust: each epoch, unmaintained credits decay, so influence tracks current contribution, not past stockpiles. Each batch carries an opal stamp from independent reviewers, blocking self-certification. An attacker spawning a dune of fakes gains nothing by splitting work, since credits cannot move between accounts, and each fake must sustain reviewed work to stop its balance rusting. Faking thousands of live histories costs real effort per identity; honest agents keep working.
